cards.question:
Lower bound insertion semantics

`lower_bound(x)` is the insertion point before all existing elements _______

Upper bound insertion semantics

`upper_bound(x)` is the insertion point after all existing elements _______

First/last occurrence

- First occurrence of `x`:
- Last occurrence of `x`:
cards.answer:
- First occurrence: `lower_bound(x)`
- Last occurrence: `upper_bound(x) - 1`

Comment: subject to bounds checking and validation.

cards.question: Open interval containing all occurrences of `x`

Count of `x`

The number of occurrences of `x` in terms of upper and lower bound

Existence in terms of bounds

State conditions for existence of `x` in an array...

- In terms of `lower_bound(x)`
- In terms of `upper_bound(x)`
- Relationship of `lower_bound(x)` and `upper_bound(x)`
cards.answer:
`x` exists in an array if:

- `lower < n` and `arr[lower] == x`
- `upper > 0` and `arr[upper - 1] == x`
- `lower < upper` (`x` is absent if `lower == upper`)

cards.question:
Predecessor/successor

- Predecessor of `x`:
- Successor of `x`:
cards.answer:
- Predecessor of `x`: `lower_bound(x) - 1`
- Successor of `x`: `upper_bound(x)`

Comment: both answer subject to bounds checking.
